mechanism_narrative: The monotone four-week contraction in TRANSIT (from -40.6 at t-3w to -50.0 at t-0w) marks a deepening mobility shutdown that transmits to discretionary retail footfall with a one-to-two week lag, so RETAIL_REC keeps falling over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: The forward 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC exceeds the trailing 28-day mean of -38.25 while TRANSIT keeps declining week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: Each further week-on-week drop in TRANSIT of at least 3 points signals an additional administrative closure of non-essential activity, which forces the retail-and-recreation series to a new lower step within seven days.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT posts a further week-on-week decline of 3 points or more (t-2w -37.3 to t-0w -50.0 already crossed a 8-point drop)
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT dropped 12.7 points from t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: A week-on-week TRANSIT decline of 3 points or more is not followed within 7 days by a RETAIL_REC weekly mean at or below the t-0w level of -46.1.

mechanism_narrative: Residential time rising to +14.3 while workplaces fall to -29.4 means households substitute home-based activity for out-of-home routines; this interaction suppresses discretionary retail trips far more than either series alone, holding RETAIL_REC down for the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL above +13 and WORKPLACES below -27 simultaneously
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC averages above -40 over the next 28 days while RESIDENTIAL stays at or above +13 and WORKPLACES stays at or below -27.

mechanism_narrative: Grocery-and-pharmacy near baseline (-7.9) while RETAIL_REC sits at -46.1 means residual mobility is essential-only; the 37-point gap is the closure wedge, and it closes only when policy eases, so forward retail stays below the trailing mean.
candidate_trigger: the RETAIL_REC minus GROCERY_PHARM gap remains below -30 points
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM held at -7.9 in t-0w versus RETAIL_REC -46.1
failure_condition: The RETAIL_REC minus GROCERY_PHARM gap widens above -30 points for two consecutive weeks and the forward 28-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds -38.25.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS swung from +29.7 to -2.6 inside one week, showing the park series is dominated by transient weather and holiday effects rather than retail demand; the coming spring daylight reallocates leisure hours outdoors and away from indoor retail-and-recreation venues.
candidate_trigger: PARKS recovers above 0 for two consecutive weeks
regime_hint: seasonal spring transition under active restrictions
failure_condition: PARKS stays above 0 for two consecutive weeks while RETAIL_REC weekly means fall at or below the t-0w level of -46.1.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has already dropped 15.1 points in two weeks to -46.1, so incremental tightening has little non-essential activity left to remove; the series saturates near a floor and its next 28-day mean reverts upward toward the -45 plateau.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC at or below -45 for two consecutive weeks (t-1w -44.9 and t-0w -46.1)
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC prints below -50 in either of the next two weeks and the forward 28-day mean stays under -38.25.

mechanism_narrative: A joint turn in TRANSIT and GROCERY_PHARM toward baseline is the first observable signature of an easement of retail restrictions; when both recover together, discretionary retail-and-recreation follows higher within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises 5 points or more week-on-week for two consecutive weeks while GROCERY_PHARM rises above -6
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -8.7 (t-3w) to -7.9 (t-0w) while TRANSIT fell to -50.0
failure_condition: TRANSIT gains 5 points or more in two consecutive weeks with GROCERY_PHARM above -6 and the forward 28-day RETAIL_REC mean still does not exceed -38.25.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES has fallen every week to -29.4, removing commuter volume that normally seeds transit-adjacent retail and recreation trips; absence of the commute channel pins RETAIL_REC below its trailing level over the next week.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES at or below -25 for three consecutive weeks
failure_condition: In the week after WORKPLACES sits at or below -25, RETAIL_REC rises above the t-0w weekly mean of -46.1.
